tasks.title: check-links include fix
tasks.request: Latest commit on master, not from this session
tasks.summary: fumadocs-mdx 15.4.10 moved include handling to fumadocs-core and stopped passing a VFile to the parser, so check-links lost each partial's path. The anchor compiler now passes the parser as a plugin option and recovers the path from the plugin's addDependency call. Fixed the Gates job on the Dependabot bump.

items.note: Matches the text the include plugin parses back to the file it announced through addDependency, so links inside partials are still reported with their real source line.
